title: Technical Support Engineer
description: A roadmap for IT and product support careers: troubleshooting, operating systems, networking, customer communication, ticketing, scripting, and escalation.

tree.name: IT Support Foundations
tree.description: Learn operating systems, hardware, networking, browsers, accounts, permissions, common errors, and structured troubleshooting.

resources.title: Technical Support Engineer Full Course in Hindi
IT Support vs Technical Support vs Desktop Support (Raymond Roshan)
Skills Required for Technical Support (BA Professional)

children.name: OS and Hardware Basics
children.description: Troubleshoot Windows/macOS/Linux basics, drivers, storage, memory, printers, updates, browsers, and device issues.

children.name: Networking and Web Basics
children.description: Use ping, DNS lookup, traceroute, IP config, Wi-Fi checks, VPN troubleshooting, HTTP status codes, and browser devtools.

tree.name: Ticketing and Customer Communication
tree.description: Resolve issues through clear questions, reproduction steps, prioritization, SLAs, empathy, and complete ticket notes.

children.name: Ticket Quality
children.description: Write summaries, environment details, reproduction steps, impact, severity, troubleshooting tried, and next actions.

children.name: Communication and De-escalation
children.description: Use calm language, expectation setting, escalation updates, customer education, and concise follow-ups.

children.name: Practice: Ticket Triage Queue
children.description: Prioritize sample support tickets, ask clarifying questions, document reproduction, and write customer updates.

tree.name: Product and Technical Troubleshooting
tree.description: Support SaaS and software products with logs, APIs, databases, integrations, auth, and monitoring context.

children.name: Logs, APIs, and Integrations
children.description: Inspect logs, API responses, webhooks, payloads, auth failures, rate limits, and integration errors.

children.name: SQL and Scripting
children.description: Read database records safely, write simple SQL, automate checks with scripts, and create support utilities.

tree.name: Knowledge Base and Career Readiness
tree.description: Improve support quality through documentation, runbooks, macros, internal tools, metrics, and escalation playbooks.

children.name: Knowledge Base and Runbooks
children.description: Create troubleshooting articles, known issue pages, escalation checklists, incident notes, and customer-facing guides.

children.name: Project: Helpdesk Troubleshooting Lab
children.description: Create sample tickets, reproduce issues, write resolutions, build a KB, add scripts, and report support metrics.
